verdict.rationale: Brave Search API documents AI-generated answers, summaries, and POI descriptions, but all of them are grounded in Brave's public web index. Nothing in the pack shows the product generating insights or suggestions from the user's own data. The query 'suggestions' endpoint is autocomplete, an adjacent feature, so the AI features earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
